purpose: Teach: 友の会/回分/新譜/吹き替え/データー/ゲージ/コンソール/特番

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、市民の友の会の活動研究を続けろ
lines.en: Ren, keep working on your research into the Citizens' Society activities.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Evenly paced. No inflection wasted. The tone of someone who trusts competence and expects follow-through.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験は三十回分のデータを集めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll collect data from thirty experimental sessions.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Straightforward delivery. Slightly faster pace than his boss—showing eagerness to get to work. No flourish, just commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、現代音楽の新譜分析の論文を読め
lines.en: Ren, read the paper on contemporary music analysis and new releases.
lines.style: Firm assignment, not a suggestion. Brief pause after the name. Steady eye contact implied. The cadence of someone who knows what needs to be done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外論文の吹き替えナレーションを作ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll create dubbed narration for the overseas papers.
lines.style: Focused and willing. Speaks a bit quickly—eager to demonstrate he's understood. Slight lift at the end, showing he's ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、市場調査のデーター集計を慎重におこなえ
lines.en: Ren, conduct the market research data compilation carefully.
lines.style: Emphasis on 'carefully'—a quiet warning under professional tone. Deliberate pacing. Not harsh, but notes precision matters here.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置のゲージ較正を担当します
lines.en: Yes. I'll take charge of calibrating the experimental equipment gauges.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Measured pace. The slight formality of someone accepting responsibility seriously, not rushing the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のコンソール環境を整えろ
lines.en: Ren, get the lab console environment set up.
lines.style: Clear directive. Brief, no softening. Expects it to be done. Efficient delivery—no wasted breath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究成果の特番ドキュメンタリーを制作します
lines.en: Yes. I'll produce the special documentary about our research findings.
lines.style: Affirming close. Voice settles with resolve. Slightly warmer than previous responses—a small relief that work is understood. Quiet satisfaction in the commitment.
